A.name: patient-portal
A.description: web front end; calls the auth service and the records API
A.priority_rationale: Nothing else depends on it; once the services it calls are healthy it works again.

B.name: auth-service
B.description: login and token verification; counts failed logins per source IP
B.provides: sign people in and check their access
B.priority_rationale: Every access to records is checked here; the Patient Portal and the EHR API both need it.

C.name: records-api
C.description: token-protected patient records; reads from the database
C.priority_rationale: The Patient Portal needs it to show records; it also needs the Login & Access Service and the database.

D.name: database
D.priority_rationale: It holds the records every other service reads; restoring it first lets the others recover against a healthy source.
